mapper.select: WITH requested_site AS ( SELECT CAST(#{siteId} AS UUID) AS site_id ), default_scene AS ( SELECT scene.id, scene.scene_code, scene.name FROM mine_scene scene JOIN requested_site requested ON requested.site_id = scene.site_id WHERE scene.status = 'ACTIVE' AND scene.default_scene ), published_version AS ( SELECT version.id, version.scene_id, version.coordinate_system_id, version.revision_number, version.schema_version, version.coordinate_mode, version.origin_x, version.origin_y, version.origin_z, version.heading_degrees, version.pitch_degrees, version.roll_degrees, version.scale, version.default_camera, version.fallback_viewport, version.content_hash, version.published_at FROM mine_scene_version version JOIN default_scene scene ON scene.id = version.scene_id JOIN requested_site requested ON requested.site_id = version.site_id WHERE version.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) SELECT scene.id AS sceneId, scene.scene_code AS sceneCode, scene.name AS sceneName, version.id AS versionId, version.coordinate_system_id AS coordinateSystemId, version.revision_number AS revisionNumber, version.schema_version AS schemaVersion, version.coordinate_mode AS coordinateMode, version.origin_x AS originX, version.origin_y AS originY, version.origin_z AS originZ, version.heading_degrees AS headingDegrees, version.pitch_degrees AS pitchDegrees, version.roll_degrees AS rollDegrees, version.scale AS sceneScale, version.default_camera::TEXT AS defaultCameraJson, version.fallback_viewport::TEXT AS fallbackViewportJson, version.content_hash AS contentHash, version.published_at AS publishedAt, COUNT(layer.id) OVER (PARTITION BY version.id) AS layerCount, layer.id AS layerId, layer.layer_code AS layerCode, layer.order_number AS orderNumber, layer.layer_type AS layerType, layer.visible, layer.opacity, layer.minimum_distance AS minimumDistance, layer.maximum_distance AS maximumDistance, layer.offset_x AS offsetX, layer.offset_y AS offsetY, layer.offset_z AS offsetZ, layer.heading_degrees AS layerHeadingDegrees, layer.pitch_degrees AS layerPitchDegrees, layer.roll_degrees AS layerRollDegrees, layer.scale AS layerScale, layer.max_items AS maxItems, layer.options::TEXT AS optionsJson, asset.id AS assetId, asset.asset_type AS assetType, asset.status AS assetStatus, asset.content_digest AS assetContentDigest, asset.entry_path AS assetEntryPath, asset.file_count AS assetFileCount FROM requested_site requested LEFT JOIN default_scene scene ON TRUE LEFT JOIN published_version version ON version.scene_id = scene.id LEFT JOIN mine_scene_layer layer ON layer.site_id = requested.site_id AND layer.scene_version_id = version.id LEFT JOIN mine_scene_asset asset ON asset.site_id = requested.site_id AND asset.id = layer.asset_id ORDER BY layer.order_number NULLS LAST, layer.id
